meta.title: About us: a technology company in Kigali
meta.description: One Kigali team for design, software, hardware and IT support. Meet the people behind Linse and MacyePay and see how we work with businesses in Rwanda.

hero.title: Building the digital backbone of growing businesses.

story.heading: One team for everything your business runs on.

story.label: Our story
story.text: Linse is a Kigali-based technology company. It started as a small software studio, and the businesses we built for kept asking the same question: who will make all of this work together?

scope.label: The scope
scope.text: So we widened the scope. Today we design and build software to a brief, publish products we own and operate, distribute business-grade hardware and run IT on contract. One team, one point of contact, and the same standard across all of it: it has to run.

serve.label: Who we serve
serve.text: We work with retailers, lenders, clinics, schools and public institutions across Rwanda and the region. Most of our work is integration: making existing systems, new products and the devices they run on share data reliably.

software.title: Software solutions
software.text: Design, websites, apps and systems built to a brief.

publishing.title: Publishing & owning software
publishing.text: Products we invest in and license to the market.

hardware.title: Hardware sales & distribution
hardware.text: Devices sourced, delivered and supported nationwide.

services.title: IT services
services.text: Help desk, networks, cloud and security, on contract.

2022.title: Founded in Kigali
2022.text: Linse starts as a software studio building websites and systems for local businesses.

2024.title: MacyePay
2024.text: We publish our first product: installment payments with legal recovery.

2025.title: Hardware distribution
2025.text: Authorised distribution of business-grade devices and networking.

2026.title: Linsetech
2026.text: Software, products, hardware and IT services under one roof.

quote.text: We do not sell software, hardware or support. We sell the fact that, on Monday morning, everything works.
quote.name: Founder & CEO

people.statement: Linse is led by people who build, ship and support what they sell. Our focus is reliability, ownership, clarity and service.
